#[test]
fn test_vector_stack_type_checking_valid() {
    let source = "
        func main() {
            mut ctx := os.Arena.New();
            defer ctx.Free();
            mut vec: std.Vector[int, ctx] := std.VectorNew(ctx);
            vec.Push(10);
            mut val: int := vec.Pop();
            vec.Push(20);
            mut ptr: *int := vec.Back();
            vec.Clear();
        }
    ";
    assert!(check_program(source).is_ok());
}

#[test]
fn test_vector_back_mutability_accepted() {
    let source = "
        func main() {
            mut ctx := os.Arena.New();
            defer ctx.Free();
            mut vec: std.Vector[int, ctx] := std.VectorNew(ctx);
            vec.Push(10);
            unsafe {
                mut ptr: *int := vec.Back();
                *ptr = 20;
            }
        }
    ";
    assert!(check_program(source).is_ok());
}
